title: Bell UH-1H (Microsoft)
sources: Cockpit input events enumerated from MSFS 2024 12.2.282174.999 (msfs-linux-companion --dump-controls), aircraft microsoft_uh1h, 2026-11-26
Checked on the running helicopter, MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked; read back with the simulation variables named in each note)

entries.name: HELICOPTER_ENGINE_GOV
entries.note: Verified on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024 (2026-11-26): 0 = governor on ((A:ROTOR GOV ACTIVE:1) = 1); cold and dark is 0.

entries.name: MB_ROTOR_BRAKE
entries.note: Verified on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024 (2026-11-26): 1 applies the rotor brake ((A:ROTOR BRAKE ACTIVE) = 1, the handle moves to 100 %), 0 releases it.

entries.name: PROCEDURE_AUTOSTART
entries.note: Verified on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024 (2026-11-26): one event starts the engine by the sim's own procedure (battery on, throttle full; rotor at 100 % in about 50 s).

entries.name: HELICOPTER_ENGINE_IDLE_RELEASE_1
entries.note: Verified on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024 (2026-11-26): 1 lets the throttle go below the idle stop (0 = cut-off). With the engine stopped it could not be set back to 0 (it stayed 1).

entries.name: HELICOPTER_ENGINE_THROTTLE_1
entries.note: Verified on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024 (2026-11-26): takes 0 to 1 (read back 0 to 100). Without the idle release a value below 0.25 stops at 0.25, the idle stop (N1 about 65 %); with HELICOPTER_ENGINE_IDLE_RELEASE_1 = 1, 0 cuts the engine. Full is 1 (the governor then holds the rotor at 100 %). AXIS_HELICOPTER_THROTTLE_SET does nothing here.

entries.name: ELECTRICAL_BATTERY_1
entries.note: Verified on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024 (2026-11-26): 1 = ON, 0 = OFF (the autostart sets 1; (A:ELECTRICAL MASTER BATTERY:1) and (A:CIRCUIT ON:1) follow).

entries.name: FUEL_FUEL_MASTER_SWITCH
entries.note: 0 in cold and dark and with the engine running after the sim's autostart, so 0 is likely ON. Not confirmed.
